Furthermore, two-step metabolism was assessed for hydroxysafflor yellow A, that is, P450-mediated oxidation followed by catechol-O-methyltransferase-mediated methylation and P450-mediated oxidation followed by glutathione conjugation. Given that intravenous hydroxysafflor yellow A is poorly excreted into bile, intestinal microbiotamediated reduction or dehydration was not considered for this compound.
